For the full year 2026, the Company expects: Total revenues in the range of $38.2 billion to $39.4 billion. (accession 0000318154-26-000124, 8-K exhibit 99.1) Scope: total revenues (product sales plus other revenues), reported USD.

AstraZeneca reconfirms Total Revenue and Core EPS guidance for FY 2026 at CER, based on the average foreign exchange rates through 2025. Total Revenue is expected to increase by a mid-to-high single-digit percentage (accession 0001104659-26-086846, 6-K main document; the H1 and Q2 2026 results are the 6-K itself, not an exhibit) Growth at constant exchange rates. "Mid-to-high single-digit" is not a number, so value, low and high are blank. Scope: Total Revenue (Product Revenue plus Collaboration Revenue). The release adds that at June 2026 average rates currency would add a low single-digit percentage to Total Revenue versus CER. A 2026-09-01 6-K (accession 0001654954-26-007986) says the Zegfrovy transaction does not impact financial guidance.

Full year total revenue is now expected to increase by a mid-single digit percentage for 2026 as compared to 2025 driven by continued revenue growth from our Growth Portfolio. (accession 0000875045-26-000073, 8-K exhibit 99.1) Growth on a reported basis: GAAP total revenue (the release says Biogen guides no GAAP measure other than revenue), assuming foreign exchange rates as of July 24, 2026 hold for the rest of the year; no constant-currency basis is stated. "Mid-single digit" is not a number, so value, low and high are blank.
